source.robots_observation: Kohl's publicly declares https://www.kohls.com/sitemap.xml. No access-control bypass or private endpoint was used.

pilot_results.offer_scope_note: Men's Nike Black/XS and kids' Nike Black/SMALL received variant-level in-stock offers because the live pages explicitly showed selected color, selected size, SKU and Add to Cart. The Levi's Lapis Speed SKU received a color-level variant and availability=unknown because no size was selected.

sampled_products.product: Men's Nike Club Pullover Fleece Hoodie
Kids 8-20 Nike Sportswear Club Embroidered Logo Fleece Pullover Hoodie in Regular & Plus

deduplication.reason: Kohl's prd IDs and SKUs are retailer-side identifiers. They remain in RetailerOffer/source provenance and are not treated as manufacturer-global product identity.

image_policy: Kohl's pages expose retailer-hosted product images, but none were promoted into ProductMaster public image fields. Attribution alone is not treated as display permission.
next_scope: Kohl's cannot be called exhaustive until a permitted bulk source accessible to the ingestion environment is available. Do not infer size/color matrices or local stock from general selectors or size charts.
